title: 第0013章高考前夜的阴影与微光第0014章凰溪岛诡异初现 低语侵蚀的疯狂

第一节：血染的休整
地下水脉的湿冷空气还未散尽，贾黑米、才依依、花呗呗和猫和四人跌跌撞撞地走上后巷的石阶。天边泛起鱼肚白，清晨的第一缕阳光穿透云层，洒在赤霄武道馆的废墟上，却驱散不掉那股浓重的铁锈味。
贾黑米瘫坐在一块完好的石阶上，指尖还残留着心灵净化后反噬的刺痛。他低头看着自己的手掌，淡蓝色的气血光晕变得无比稀薄，序列【心灵者·一阶】的能力仿佛被抽走了大半。昨夜那场战斗中，他强行催动能力净化黑渊的侵蚀，不仅气血消耗殆尽，连心灵层面都留下了难以愈合的裂痕，耳边似乎还能听到邪神低语的残响。
“叶老……”才依依攥紧了长刀，刀身的金色符文已经黯淡下去。她回想起石室里叶利西的虚影消散时的画面，鼻尖微微发酸。叶老守护凰溪岛百年，最终却以残魂献祭封印黑渊，这份沉重的牺牲像一块巨石压在她心头。她摸了摸眉心的封印符文，那里的血脉共鸣还在隐隐发烫，提醒着她肩上的使命。
猫和甩了甩受伤的爪子，青色的火焰只剩下微弱的光点。它跳到贾黑米腿上，蜷缩起身子，喉咙里发出细碎的呜咽声。昨夜为了按住心核，它的皮毛被黑色黏液腐蚀掉好几块，露出粉红色的嫩肉，此刻正传来阵阵刺痛。
花呗呗靠在井边，掏出一支棒棒糖塞进嘴里，却没尝到甜味。她看着自己的手腕，那里浮现出一张淡金色的契约虚影——用十年寿命兑换全员满状态的契约还在生效，她能清晰地感觉到生命的流逝在加速。叶利西答应帮她续命的承诺还回荡在耳边，但她不知道这份承诺是否真的能兑现。
“陈赤霄的尸体……不见了。”贾黑米突然开口，打破了沉默。他的声音有些沙哑，目光扫过废墟，“昨夜幻境里他残躯化作灰烬，可刚才回来的路上，我特意去看了储物柜的位置，连一点灰烬都没留下。”
才依依皱起眉头：“黑渊的侵蚀还没结束？他的执念或许还附着在什么地方？”
“不止是陈赤霄。”花呗呗吐掉棒棒糖棍，从背包里翻出一张平板，调出凰溪岛的新闻页面，“你们看，昨夜全岛有二十三个武道馆的学员突然失踪，监控里只拍到他们走向废弃的训练场，然后就消失了。”
平板屏幕上，一段段模糊的监控画面闪过。那些失踪的学员双眼空洞，步履蹒跚，像行尸走肉一样走向黑暗，最后被一股无形的力量吞噬。贾黑米的心猛地一沉，他想起昨夜幻境里陈赤霄说的话：“高考在即，更多人要崩溃……”
“黑渊在利用武道高考的压力，放大考生的执念，把他们变成邪神的养料。”贾黑米握紧拳头，“高考还有三天，这些失踪的学员，恐怕已经变成了新的执念结晶。”
才依依站起身，长刀在地面划出刺耳的声响：“必须找到他们！我去查家族古籍，看看有没有追踪执念结晶的方法。你先去联系官方武者协会，让他们封锁所有废弃训练场。”
她顿了顿，看向花呗呗：“你用交易师的能力，看看能不能查到这些失踪学员的位置——如果有人暗中交易执念结晶，你应该能发现契约波动。”
花呗呗耸耸肩：“没问题，但得先付定金。”她伸出三根手指，“三瓶草莓味能量饮料，外加五年内你赢的武道比赛奖金分我一成。”
“成交。”贾黑米毫不犹豫地答应下来。
猫和“喵呜”一声，从贾黑米腿上跳下来，尾巴指向远处的码头：“喵……那里有线索。”它的爪子上燃起微弱的青焰，指引着方向。
四人没有再多言，迅速分工行动。贾黑米激活心灵罗盘，虽然昨夜被侵蚀后指针有些迟钝，但仍能隐约捕捉到执念的波动。才依依的长刀插在背后，金色的血脉光晕护在周身，警惕着周围的异常。花呗呗低头摆弄着平板，指尖浮现出淡金色的契约符文，搜索着交易波动。猫和走在最前面，青焰照亮了前方的阴影。
第二节：码头的交易陷阱
清晨的码头异常安静，只有海浪拍打着岸边的声音。往日里喧闹的渔船都不见踪影，码头上停泊着一艘黑色的快艇，船身上没有任何标识，看起来格外诡异。

猫和的爪子突然停下，耳朵警惕地竖起：“喵……就在里面。”它指向快艇的船舱。
贾黑米示意大家停下，自己悄悄靠近快艇。透过船舱的玻璃，他看到里面站着三个身穿黑色风衣的男人，他们的脸上戴着面具，正围着一个金属箱子交谈。箱子里摆满了黑色的执念结晶，表面的人脸发出压抑的啜泣声，让人不寒而栗。
“这批结晶的质量不错，都是临近高考的学员，执念够深。”一个矮个子男人的声音传来，“黑渊大人说，高考当天，我们要把这些结晶埋进考场地下，让所有考生的执念爆发。”
“陈赤霄那家伙呢？不是说他负责收集结晶吗？”另一个高个子男人问道。
“他被那几个小鬼坏了好事，现在已经被黑渊大人的触手吞噬，变成了结晶的一部分。”第三个男人冷笑一声，“不过没关系，没有他我们一样能完成任务。等高考结束，黑渊大人就能彻底觉醒，那时整个凰溪岛都会变成执念的乐园。”
贾黑米的心跳骤然加快，原来陈赤霄真的已经彻底被黑渊侵蚀，变成了邪神的养料。他正想后退通知才依依，突然感觉到一股冰冷的视线落在自己身上。
“谁在外面？”高个子男人猛地转头，目光透过玻璃锁定了贾黑米。他抬手挥出一道黑色的刀气，击破玻璃，劈向贾黑米。
“快跑！”贾黑米大喊一声，立刻激活序列【心灵者·一阶】，淡蓝色的气血光晕在周身形成屏障。刀气击中屏障，发出“嗡”的一声，屏障剧烈震荡，贾黑米被震得后退三步，嘴角溢出鲜血。
船舱里的三个男人迅速冲出快艇，他们的身上燃起黑色的气血光晕，显然是被黑渊侵蚀的序列者。矮个子男人激活序列【盗贼·二阶】，身影瞬间消失在原地，下一秒出现在贾黑米身后，匕首刺向他的后心。
“小心！”才依依纵身跃起，长刀挥舞，金色的火焰斩断了匕首。她落地的同时，刀锋直指矮个子男人的喉咙，逼得他连连后退。
高个子男人激活序列【蛮力者·三阶】，肌肉暴涨，一拳砸向贾黑米。贾黑米双手按地，淡蓝色的心灵波纹扩散，试图干扰他的意志。但男人的意志早已被黑渊污染，波纹对他几乎没有作用。拳风带着腥臭味扑面而来，贾黑米只能勉强侧身躲开，肩膀还是被拳风擦到，火辣辣地疼。
第三个男人激活序列【傀儡师·二阶】，双手结印，码头上的集装箱突然动了起来，无数金属碎片汇聚成傀儡巨人，向花呗呗扑去。花呗呗冷笑一声，甩出八张契约符纸，符纸化作锁链缠住傀儡巨人的四肢：“以交易师之名，暂停动作一分钟！”

Section One: Blood-stained Rest
The cold and humid air in the underground water veins had not yet dissipated. Jia Heimi, Cai Yiyi, Hua Beibei and Maohe stumbled up the stone steps of the back alley. The sky turned white, and the first ray of sunshine in the morning penetrated the clouds and sprinkled on the ruins of the Chixiao Martial Arts Gym, but it could not dispel the strong smell of rust.
Jiahemi sat slumped on an intact stone step, the backlash of the purification of his soul still lingering on his fingertips. He looked down at his palm, and the light blue halo of energy and blood became extremely thin, and most of the ability of the sequence [Psychic: First Level] seemed to have been taken away. In the battle last night, he forcibly activated his ability to purify the erosion of the black abyss. Not only was his energy and blood exhausted, but he also left cracks in his soul that were difficult to heal. It seemed that he could still hear the reverberation of the evil god's whisper in his ears.
"Mr. Ye..." Cai Yiyi tightened her grip on the long knife, and the golden runes on the blade had dimmed. She recalled the scene when Ye Lixi's shadow disappeared in the stone room, and the tip of her nose felt slightly sore. Elder Ye had guarded Huangxi Island for hundreds of years, but in the end he sacrificed his remaining soul to seal the Black Abyss. This heavy sacrifice weighed on her heart like a huge boulder. She touched the sealing rune between her eyebrows. The blood resonance there was still faintly hot, reminding her of the mission on her shoulders.
Mao He shook his injured paw, and only a faint light spot remained in the blue flame. It jumped onto Jiahemi's lap, curled up, and made a thin whimpering sound in its throat. Last night, in order to hold down the core of the heart, several pieces of its fur were corroded by black mucus, exposing the pink tender flesh, and it was experiencing bursts of pain at this moment.
Hua Beibei leaned against the well, took out a lollipop and stuffed it into her mouth, but she didn't taste the sweetness. She looked at her wrist, where a pale golden shadow of a contract appeared - the contract of exchanging ten years of life for full status was still in effect, and she could clearly feel the passage of life accelerating. Ye Lixi's promise to help her renew her life still echoed in her ears, but she didn't know if this promise could really be fulfilled.
"Chen Chixiao's body...is missing." Jia Heimi suddenly spoke, breaking the silence. His voice was a little hoarse, and his eyes swept across the ruins, "Last night in the fantasy, his remains were reduced to ashes, but on the way back just now, I specifically checked the location of the locker, and there was not even a trace of ashes left."
Cai Yiyi frowned: "The erosion of the black abyss is not over yet? Maybe his obsession is still attached somewhere?"
"It's not just Chen Chixiao." Hua Beibei spit out the lollipop stick, took out a tablet from her backpack, and brought up the news page of Huangxi Island. "You see, twenty-three students from the martial arts halls on the island suddenly disappeared last night. The surveillance cameras only captured them walking towards the abandoned training ground, and then disappeared."
On the flat screen, blurry surveillance images flashed across the screen. The missing students had empty eyes and staggered steps, walking towards the darkness like zombies, and were finally swallowed up by an invisible force. Jia Heimi's heart suddenly sank. He remembered what Chen Chixiao said in the dream last night: "The college entrance examination is around the corner, and more people will collapse..."
"Heiyuan is taking advantage of the pressure of the martial arts college entrance examination to amplify the candidates' obsessions and turn them into nourishment for evil gods." Jia Heimi clenched his fists, "There are still three days left for the college entrance examination. These missing students may have become the crystallization of new obsessions."
Cai Yiyi stood up, and the long knife made a sharp sound on the ground: "We must find them! I will check the ancient family books to see if there is a way to track the crystallization of obsession. You first contact the official warrior association and ask them to seal off all abandoned training grounds."
She paused and looked at Huabei: "Use your ability as a trader to see if you can find the location of these missing students - if someone secretly trades the crystal of obsession, you should be able to detect fluctuations in the contract."
Hua Beibei shrugged: "No problem, but you have to pay a deposit first." She held out three fingers, "Three bottles of strawberry-flavored energy drinks, plus the prize money for martial arts competitions you won within five years.Give me 10%. "
"make a deal. "Jiahemi agreed without hesitation.
The cat said "meow", jumped down from Jahimi's lap, and pointed its tail to the dock in the distance: "Meow... there are clues there. "A faint green flame ignited on its paws, guiding the direction.
The four of them did not say anything more and quickly divided their work into actions. Jiahemi activated the spiritual compass. Although the pointer was a little slow after being eroded last night, he could still vaguely capture the fluctuations of obsession. Cai Yiyi's long knife was stuck in her back, and the golden blood halo protected her whole body, alerting her to any anomalies around her. Hua Beibei lowered her head and fiddled with the tablet. Light golden contract runes appeared on her fingertips, searching for transaction fluctuations. Mao He walked in the front, the green flames lighting up the shadows in front.
Section 2: The trading trap of the terminal
The pier was unusually quiet in the early morning, with only the sound of waves lapping on the shore. The noisy fishing boats of the past are gone. There is a black speedboat moored on the pier. There is no mark on the boat, which looks particularly strange.
Mao He's paws suddenly stopped, and his ears stood up alertly: "Meow...it's inside. ” It pointed toward the cabin of the speedboat.
Jahimi signaled everyone to stop and quietly approached the speedboat. Through the glass of the cabin, he saw three men in black trench coats standing inside, with masks on their faces, talking around a metal box. The box is filled with black crystals of obsession, and the human face on the surface emits suppressed sobs, which makes people shudder.
“The quality of this batch of crystals is good, they are all students who are about to take the college entrance examination, and their obsession is deep enough. "The voice of a short man came, "Master Heiyuan said, on the day of the college entrance examination, we will bury these crystals under the examination venue to let all the candidates' obsessions explode. "
"Where's that guy Chen Chixiao? Didn't it mean that he was responsible for collecting crystals? asked another tall man.
"He was ruined by those little brats, and now he has been swallowed up by Lord Black Abyss's tentacles and turned into a part of the crystal. The third man sneered, "But it doesn't matter. We can complete the mission without him." When the college entrance examination is over, Master Heiyuan will be able to fully awaken, and then the entire Huangxi Island will become a paradise of obsession. "
Jia Heimi's heartbeat suddenly accelerated. It turned out that Chen Chixiao had really been completely eroded by the black abyss and turned into the nourishment of the evil god. He was about to step back and inform Cai Yiyi when he suddenly felt a cold gaze falling on him.
"Who's out there? "The tall man turned his head suddenly and locked his eyes on Jiahemi through the glass. He raised his hand and waved a black sword energy, breaking the glass and hitting Jiahemi.
"Run! "Jia Heimi shouted and immediately activated the sequence [Psychic One Level 1]. The light blue halo of energy and blood formed a barrier around him. The sword energy hit the barrier and made a "buzz" sound. The barrier shook violently. Jia Heimi was shocked and took three steps back, with blood spilling from the corner of his mouth.
The three men in the cabin quickly rushed out of the speedboat. Their bodies were ignited with a black halo of energy and blood. They were obviously Sequencers eroded by the black abyss. The short man activated the sequence [Rogue·Second Level], and his figure disappeared instantly. The next second, he appeared behind Jiahemi, stabbing him in the back with a dagger.
"Be careful! "Cai Yiyi jumped up, swung the long knife, and the golden flame cut off the dagger. When she landed, the blade was pointed directly at the short man's throat, forcing him to retreat repeatedly.
The tall man activated the sequence [Brute Force: Level 3], his muscles surged, and he punched Jiahemi. Jiahemi pressed his hands on the ground, and light blue spiritual ripples spread, trying to interfere with his will. But the man's will has long been contaminated by the black abyss, and the ripples have almost no effect on him. The wind from the fist hit his face with a fishy smell, and Jia Heimi could only barely move sideways to avoid it. His shoulder was still rubbed by the wind from the fist, causing burning pain.
The third man activated the sequence [Puppet Master·Level 2] and formed seals with his hands. The container on the dock suddenly moved, and countless metal fragments gathered into puppets.The giant pounced towards Hua Beibei. Hua Beibei sneered and threw out eight contract talismans. The talismans turned into chains and wrapped around the limbs of the puppet giant: "In the name of the trader, pause the action for one minute!"
